business_model.claim: Dorian LPG owns and operates very large gas carriers (VLGCs) that carry liquefied petroleum gas by sea; it sells seaborne transportation capacity.
quotes: Specifically, Dorian and its subsidiaries are focused on owning and operating VLGCs in the LPG shipping industry.

business_model.claim: The company reports one segment, the international transportation of LPG, and does not disclose geographic information.
quotes: Based on this, we have determined that we operate in one reportable segment, the international transportation of LPG.

business_model.claim: Almost all revenue comes through the Helios Pool as net pool revenues from a related party: about 99%, 97% and 95% in the last three fiscal years.
quotes: For the years ended March 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024 approximately 99%, 97% and 95% of our revenues, respectively, were generated through the Helios Pool as net pool revenues—related party.

business_model.claim: The Helios Pool is a 50/50 joint venture with MOL Energia. Members share pooled net revenues, weighted by vessel characteristics, and receive them as variable-rate time charter hire.
quotes: The members of the Helios Pool share in the net pool revenues generated by the entire group of vessels participating in the pool, weighted according to certain technical vessel characteristics, and net pool revenues are distributed as variable rate time charter hire to each participant.

business_model.claim: In the latest quarter, net pool revenues from the related party were $220,812,588 of total revenues of $221,347,756.
End customers, reached directly or through the pool, include global energy companies, commodity traders and LPG importers.
quotes: Our customers, either directly or through the Helios Pool, include or have included global energy companies such as Exxon Mobil Corp., Chevron Corp., China International United Petroleum & Chemicals Co., Ltd., Royal Dutch Shell plc, Equinor ASA, Total S.A., and Sunoco LP, commodity traders such as Glencore plc, Itochu Corporation, Bayegan Group, Gunvor Group, and the Vitol Group and importers such as E1 Corp., Indian Oil Corporation, SK Gas Co. Ltd., and Astomos Energy Corporation, or subsidiaries of the foregoing.

business_model.claim: Revenue is concentrated in the Helios Pool, but within the pool no single charterer exceeded 10% of net pool revenues in the latest fiscal year.
quotes: For the year ended March 31, 2026, the Helios Pool accounted for 99% of our total revenues.

business_model.claim: Management says revenue is driven by fleet size, operating days and the daily rates the vessels earn.
quotes: Our revenues are driven primarily by the number of vessels in our fleet, the number of days during which our vessels operate and the daily rates that our vessels earn under our charters

business_model.claim: Because the pool trades mainly in the spot market, Dorian's revenue moves with spot freight rates.
quotes: Since the members of a pool typically share in the revenue generated by the entire group of vessels in the pool, and since pools operate primarily in the spot market, including the pool in which we participate, the revenue earned by vessels placed in spot market related pools is subject to the fluctuations of the spot market and the ability of the pool manager to effectively employ its fleet.

business_model.claim: Quarterly revenue rose 78.4%, mainly because the TCE rate per available day rose from $53,725 to $96,990.
quotes: TCE rates rose by $43,265 per available day from $53,725 for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $96,990 for the three months ended September 30, 2026.

business_model.claim: Higher spot rates drove the TCE increase, partly offset by higher bunker prices. The Baltic LPG index on the benchmark route averaged $228.915 against $81.320 a year earlier.
quotes: The increase in TCE rates was primarily due to higher spot rates partially offset by higher bunker prices.

business_model.claim: Fleet size limits available days: the fleet fell to twenty-two VLGCs, five of them time chartered-in, and available days slipped from 2,290 to 2,272.
quotes: Our fleet currently consists of twenty-two VLGC carriers

business_model.claim: Demand is seasonal: the LPG shipping market has historically been stronger in autumn, ahead of winter heating demand.
quotes: The LPG shipping market historically has been stronger in the autumn months in anticipation of increased consumption of propane and butane for heating during the winter months.

business_model.claim: Scrubber-fitted vessels can earn higher TCE when refined fuel costs more than less refined fuel.
quotes: When the cost of more refined fuel exceeds that of less refined fuel, we are typically able to earn a higher TCE for spot voyages and to potentially contract time charters at higher rates compared to vessels without scrubbers.

business_model.basis: stated in P3; the voyage expense figure is from F2
business_model.claim: Under the pool arrangement the pool bears bunkers and port costs while the owner pays crew, maintenance and insurance, so Dorian's own voyage expenses were only 986,096 in the latest quarter.
quotes: Under pool arrangements, vessels typically enter the pool under a time charter agreement whereby the cost of bunkers and port expenses are borne by the charterer (i.e., the pool) and operating costs, including crews, maintenance and insurance are typically paid by the owner of the vessel.

business_model.claim: Charter hire for chartered-in vessels rose to $18.2 million, driven by higher daily rates and more chartered-in days (461 to 498).
quotes: The increase of $4.5 million, or 33.0%, was mainly driven by an increase in the average rate per time chartered-in day along with an increase in time chartered-in days from 461 for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to 498 for the three months ended September 30, 2026.

business_model.claim: Vessel operating expenses were $10,264 per vessel per calendar day. Excluding non-capitalizable drydock costs, they rose 8.4% on higher crew wages and repairs.
quotes: Excluding non-capitalizable drydock-related operating expenses, daily operating expenses increased by $799, or 8.4%, from $9,474 for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $10,273 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, mainly as a result of increases in (i) crew wages and related costs and (ii) repairs and maintenance costs.

business_model.claim: Vessels are depreciated straight-line over an estimated 25-year useful life, net of salvage value.
quotes: We depreciate our vessels on a straight‑line basis using an estimated useful life of 25 years from initial delivery from the shipyard and after considering estimated salvage values.

business_model.claim: General and administrative expenses rose to $14.0 million, driven by bonuses under the new cash incentive plan and by stock-based compensation.
quotes: General and administrative expenses were $14.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $2.0 million, or 16.8%, from $12.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, driven by increases of (i) $0.8 million in bonuses, primarily resulting from the implementation of the Annual Cash Incentive Plan (the “ACIP”), which is recognized throughout the fiscal year, (ii) $0.8 million in stock-based compensation expense, (iii) $0.3 million in employee-related costs and benefits, and (iv) $0.1 million of other general and administrative expenses for the period ended September 30, 2026 when compared to the period ended September 30, 2025.

business_model.claim: Interest and finance costs, which depend on debt levels, rose to $8.6 million because of financing-fee amortization tied to debt prepayment.
quotes: Interest and finance costs amounted to $8.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $1.0 million, or 13.1%, from $7.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

business_model.claim: Vessel sales add gains outside revenue: the gain on disposal of $63.6 million came from selling Corsair and Constellation.
quotes: Gain on disposal of vessels amounted to $63.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and was attributable to the sale of 2014-built VLGC Corsair and 2015-built VLGC Constellation.

business_model.claim: Other revenues are small and consist of charterer reimbursements, such as security and war-risk insurance costs.
quotes: Other revenues, net represent income from charterers, including the Helios Pool, relating to reimbursement of expenses such as costs for security guards and war risk insurance for voyages operating in high-risk areas.

competitive_position.claim: Dorian is a pure-play VLGC owner-operator in LPG shipping, with no diversification into other vessel types or cargoes.
quotes: We currently rely almost exclusively on the cash flow generated from the vessels in our fleet, all of which are VLGCs operating in the LPG shipping industry (including through the Helios Pool).

competitive_position.claim: Commercial employment is concentrated in the Helios Pool, which accounted for 99% of total revenues in the year ended March 31, 2026.
quotes: For the year ended March 31, 2026, the Helios Pool accounted for 99% of our total revenues.
